preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The length of permutation arrays A and P, and the number of operations Q, are each between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The elements of arrays A and P, and the positions x and y, are each between 1 and N, inclusive.
Arrays A and P are permutations of integers from 1 to N.
In operations of type 2, the positions x and y are different.

postconditions.description: For each query of type 3, output the element at position x in array A after all preceding operations have been applied.
